versions.content: If TCPIP_STATE_ONLINE is requested for an EthIf controller and the current state is TCPIP_STATE_ONHOLD for that EthIf controller, the TcpIp module shall (a) reactivate the communication within the TcpIp module for the related EthIf cont roller, (b) call Up _LocalIpAddrAssignmentChg() with State TCPIP_IPADDR_STATE_ ASSIGNED for all assigned IP addresses of the related EthIf controller, and (c) enter the state TCPIP_STATE_ON LINE for the EthIf controller .

If TCPIP_STATE_ONLINE is requested for an EthIf controller and the current state is TCPIP_STATE_ONHOLD for that EthIf controller, the TcpIp module shall (a) reactivate the communication within the TcpIp module for the related EthIf cont roller, (b) call Up _LocalIpAddrAssignmentChg() with State TCPIP_IPADDR_STATE_ ASSIGNED for all assigned IP addresses of the related EthIf controller, and Specification of TCP/IP Stack AUTO SAR CP R20 - 11 49 of 293 Document ID 617 : AUTOSAR_SWS_TcpIp (c) enter the state TCPIP_STATE_ON LINE for the EthIf controller .

If TCPIP_STATE_ONLINE is requested for an EthIf controller and the current state is TCPIP_STATE_ONHOLD for that EthIf controller, the TcpIp module shall (a) reactivate the communication within the TcpIp module for the related EthIf cont roller, (b) call Up _LocalIpAddrAssignmentChg() with State TCPIP_IPADDR_STATE_ ASSIGNED for all assigned IP addresses of the related EthIf controller, and (c) enter the state TCPIP_STATE_ON LINE for the EthIf controller .
